Title: Quality — Lily Design System

Description: Lily Core: the components Lily is prepared to call proven, the evidence each must show, and where every candidate stands today. No component has met the criteria yet.

# Quality: Lily Core

Lily Core is the set of components Lily is prepared to call proven. A component enters Core only when its evidence is in the repository. **Today Core has no members.** No candidate meets the criteria yet: the screen-reader matrix has no recorded results, so criterion (c) fails for every candidate.

## What Core means

Core is drawn from the 40 interactive components an external audit would look at first: the form family, the five helper pickers, dialogs, tabs, menus, accordion, navigation, pagination, tables and the skip link. These are the candidates. A candidate becomes a member only when all three criteria below hold, and only Core members may be called proven.

## The criteria

1. **Keyboard and ARIA-state tests in all eight libraries** (Svelte, React, Vue, Angular, HTML, Web Components, Nunjucks, Blazor). A test file counts when it sends a key event and asserts an `aria-*` attribute; the key event is waived for a component whose contract names no keys.
2. **End-to-end tests in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.**
3. **A filled screen-reader row** with a pass or minor result for each of: NVDA + Firefox, NVDA + Chrome, JAWS + Chrome, VoiceOver + Safari (macOS), VoiceOver (iOS), TalkBack + Chrome (Android).

## Where the candidates stand

Keyboard and ARIA-state tests in all eight libraries: 3 of 40. End-to-end in all three browsers: 38 of 40. Screen-reader row filled: 0 of 40. All three: 0.

Why none has met them: the [screen-reader matrix](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/docs/screen-reader-matrix.md) has 0 of 120 cells filled, because no one has yet run the components with a screen reader and recorded the result, and this project does not record results it has not observed. 17 candidates have no row in the matrix yet. The end-to-end suites run in Chromium, Firefox, WebKit.

## Read the evidence

- [docs/core.md](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/docs/core.md): every test file and spec behind each number above.
- [Accessibility conformance report](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/docs/accessibility-conformance-report.md): VPAT 2.5, WCAG 2.2 edition, self-assessed and not an independent audit.
- [Accessibility statement](https://lilydesignsystem.com/accessibility/): what is verified, and what is not verified by anything.

The page is generated by the same script that checks the evidence, and the project's test run fails if a Core member loses any of it.
